Identity & Monogram

LOGOMARK: ODDINARY STAR

Iridescent CD-star emblem fusing music culture, cyberpunk circuitry, and dreamcore pastel aesthetics.

FIG 01.0 // ODDINARY LOGOMARK
ODDINARY Star & CD Wordmark
DESIGN ARCHITECTURE

Cyberpunk Music & Dreamcore Pastel Mark

The ODDINARY logomark embodies the intersection of music, cyberpunk technology, and dreamcore pastel aesthetics. Anchored by an iridescent optical CD embedded inside a glowing pastel-gradient star—complete with circuit traces, pixel wings, and celestial sparkles—the mark balances nostalgic audio culture and futuristic cybernetic energy with soft, surreal warmth.

Sonic & Cyber Core

Holographic CD disc and circuit pathways bridging music and cyberpunk.

Dreamcore Pastel Palette

Soft cyan-to-lavender gradients paired with pixel wings and rounded typography.
